title: Annealed L\'{e}vy Diffusion via Gaussian Surrogate Reverse Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.19692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gaussian diffusion models offer a practical framework for generative modeling. Denoising L\'{e}vy Probabilistic Models (DLPM) introduce heavy-tailed perturbations with a fixed tail index throughout denoising. We introduce Annealed L\'{e}vy Diffusion (ALD). ALD varies the stability index $\alpha(t)$ to combine heavy-tailed exploration with Gaussian refinement. Our marginal-first formulation represents stable noise as a scalar Gaussian scale mixture. This formulation enables standard Gaussian noise-prediction training with one additional scale input. We study two sampling processes. ALD-renoise estimates the clean sample and injects fresh marginal noise. ALD-posterior preserves dependence between successive states through an accumulated conditional variance and a Gaussian bridge update. Both samplers reuse the same trained predictor with different scalar inputs. We evaluate ALD on four 2D benchmarks and an imbalanced nine-mode mixture. We

translated_title: 基于高斯替代反向动力学的退火Lévy扩散
translated_abstract: 高斯扩散模型为生成建模提供了一个实用的框架。去噪Lévy概率模型（DLPM）在整个去噪过程中引入尾部指数固定不变的重尾扰动。我们提出了退火Lévy扩散（ALD）。ALD通过随时间变化的稳定性指数 $\alpha(t)$，将重尾探索与高斯精炼相结合。我们的“边缘优先”表述将稳定噪声表示为标量高斯尺度混合。这一表述使得标准的Gaussian噪声预测训练只需增加一个额外的尺度输入即可实现。我们研究了两种采样过程：ALD-renoise估计干净样本并注入新的边缘噪声；ALD-posterior则通过累积的条件方差和高斯桥更新来保持相邻状态之间的依赖关系。两种采样器都复用同一个训练好的预测器，仅使用不同的标量输入。我们在四个二维基准和一个不平衡的九模态混合分布上对ALD进行了评估。
tldr: 提出退火Lévy扩散（ALD），通过随时间退火的稳定性指数将重尾探索与高斯精炼结合，并把稳定噪声表示为高斯尺度混合，从而在标准Gaussian噪声预测训练中仅需增加一个标量尺度输入即可实现。
en_tdlr: Proposes Annealed Lévy Diffusion (ALD), which anneals the stability index over time to combine heavy-tailed exploration with Gaussian refinement, and represents stable noise as a scalar Gaussian scale mixture so that standard Gaussian noise-prediction training works with only one additional scale input.
